accepted.quote: Because this bill creates unacceptable risks of a dangerous weapon being sold to or accessed by a person who may not legally have one, I must oppose this legislation in its current form and I urge my colleagues to do the same.
accepted.bill: H.R. 2255 Federal Law Enforcement Officer Service Weapon Purchase Act
accepted.rationale: The legislator explicitly states opposition to the legislation due to public-safety risks from firearm sales.
